nodes.title: AWS Transit Gateway
nodes.description:
Role: Connects all four VPCs in a hub-and-spoke model.
Config: Amazon side ASN=64512, DNS support=enabled.
Reason: Scalable and centrally managed network topology.
Addresses: REQ-028, REQ-018

nodes.title: AWS CloudTrail
nodes.description:
Role: Records all API activity across the AWS environment.
Config: Multi-region organization trail, Log File Validation=Enabled, Encrypted with KMS.
Reason: Essential for security analysis and compliance.
Addresses: REQ-005

nodes.title: AWS Backup
nodes.description:
Role: Centralizes and automates data protection.
Config: Vault Lock=Enabled, Plan=Daily backups with 35-day retention.
Reason: Centralized backup strategy.
Addresses: REQ-022

nodes.title: Amazon S3
nodes.description:
Role: Provides durable object storage for assets, logs, and IaC.
Config: SSE-KMS encryption, Versioning enabled, Block Public Access enabled.
Reason: High durability and scalability.
Addresses: REQ-004, REQ-027

nodes.title: Amazon CloudWatch
nodes.description:
Role: Collects monitoring data across all AWS services.
Config: EC2 Detailed Monitoring=Enabled, Alarms for Auto Scaling.
Reason: Foundational metrics for auto-scaling and DataDog.
Addresses: REQ-034, REQ-011

nodes.title: AWS X-Ray
nodes.description:
Role: Analyzes and debugs distributed applications.
Config: Sampling Rules=5% default, 100% for errors.
Reason: Diagnose latency bottlenecks in critical APIs.
Addresses: REQ-011

nodes.title: DataDog
nodes.description:
Role: Unified observability platform for metrics, dashboards, and alarms.
Config: AWS Integration via IAM Role, Agent on all EC2 instances.
Reason: Primary production-grade observability solution.
Addresses: REQ-034

nodes.title: Amazon GuardDuty
nodes.description:
Role: Intelligent threat detection.
Config: Data Sources=S3 Logs, VPC Flow Logs, DNS Logs.
Reason: Mandatory security service.
Addresses: N/A

nodes.title: Amazon Inspector
nodes.description:
Role: Automated vulnerability scanning for EC2 and ECR.
Config: Scan Coverage=EC2 instances & ECR images.
Reason: Meet compliance requirements.
Addresses: REQ-031

nodes.title: AWS Security Hub
nodes.description:
Role: Aggregates security findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, etc.
Reason: Single pane of glass for security alerts.
Addresses: N/A

nodes.title: AWS Key Management Service (KMS)
nodes.description:
Role: Centralized encryption key management.
Config: Customer-Managed Keys (CMKs), Key Rotation=Enabled (1 year).
Reason: Core data protection requirement.
Addresses: REQ-004, REQ-019

nodes.title: (Mgmt) Sophos UTM
nodes.description:
Role: Centralized web-filtered NAT for egress and client VPN.
Config: ASG min/max=1 per AZ, Instance Type=m5.large.
Reason: Mandated exception for egress filtering.
Addresses: REQ-017

nodes.title: (Mgmt) Amazon EC2 (Bastion Host)
nodes.description:
Role: Secure bastion host for SSH access.
Config: Instance Type=t3.small, AMI=Golden AMI, ASG Size=1.
Reason: Secure administrative access point.
Addresses: REQ-017, REQ-029

nodes.title: (Mgmt) Jenkins Server
nodes.description:
Role: Orchestrates CI/CD pipelines.
Config: Self-hosted on EC2 m5.large, EBS Volume=100 GB gp3.
Reason: Mandated by SOW as central CI/CD tool.
Addresses: REQ-007

nodes.title: Application Load Balancer
nodes.description:
Role: Distributes traffic across Beanstalk instances.
Config: Scheme=internet-facing, Listeners=HTTPS (443), Health Checks=/health.
Reason: High availability and WAF integration.
Addresses: REQ-010, REQ-004

nodes.title: AWS Secrets Manager
nodes.description:
Role: Manages and rotates DB credentials and API keys.
Config: Rotation=Enabled (90 days), Encryption=KMS.
Reason: Eliminate hardcoded secrets.
Addresses: REQ-032

nodes.title: Amazon SNS
nodes.description:
Role: Routes CloudWatch alarms to notification channels.
Config: Topics=alerts-critical, alerts-warning.
Reason: Decoupled notification layer.
Addresses: REQ-021

nodes.title: Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose
nodes.description:
Role: Ingests and delivers high-throughput streaming event data to Redshift.
Config: Source=Direct PUT, Destination=Amazon Redshift, Buffering=64 MB or 300s.
Reason: Handle high-volume event ingestion.
Addresses: REQ-012

nodes.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk (AZ-A)
nodes.description:
Role: Manages deployment and scaling of core web application.
Config: Platform=Amazon Linux 2/NGINX, Instance Type=m6g.xlarge, Scaling=2-10 instances, Strategy=Blue/Green.
Reason: Abstract infrastructure management.
Addresses: REQ-010, REQ-011, REQ-013

nodes.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk (AZ-B)
nodes.description:
Role: Manages deployment and scaling of core web application.
Config: Platform=Amazon Linux 2/NGINX, Instance Type=m6g.xlarge, Scaling=2-10 instances.
Reason: Multi-AZ high availability.
Addresses: REQ-010, REQ-013

nodes.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk (AZ-C)
nodes.description:
Role: Manages deployment and scaling of core web application.
Config: Platform=Amazon Linux 2/NGINX, Instance Type=m6g.xlarge, Scaling=2-10 instances.
Reason: Multi-AZ high availability.
Addresses: REQ-010, REQ-013

nodes.title: Amazon Aurora (Writer)
nodes.description:
Role: Primary relational database for transactional data.
Config: Engine=aurora-mysql 8.0, Class=db.r5.2xlarge, 1 writer + 2 readers, Backup Retention=30 days.
Reason: Performance and high availability requirements.
Addresses: REQ-002, REQ-016

nodes.title: Amazon ElastiCache for Redis
nodes.description:
Role: In-memory caching to reduce DB read latency.
Config: Engine=Redis, Node Type=cache.r6g.large, Clusters=2, Multi-AZ=true.
Reason: Low-latency caching solution.
Addresses: REQ-039

nodes.title: Amazon EFS
nodes.description:
Role: Shared elastic file system for Beanstalk instances across AZs.
Config: Performance Mode=generalPurpose, Throughput=elastic, Encryption=KMS.
Reason: Shared state for multi-AZ Beanstalk.
Addresses: REQ-004, REQ-027

nodes.title: AWS Database Migration Service
nodes.description:
Role: Initial data load and CDC from source database.
Config: Replication Instance=dms.c5.large, Allocated Storage=100 GB.
Reason: One-time database migration with minimal downtime.
Addresses: REQ-033, REQ-001

nodes.title: Amazon Redshift
nodes.description:
Role: Central analytics data warehouse for high-volume player event data.
Config: Node Type=ra3.4xlarge (2 nodes), Multi-AZ=true, Encryption=KMS.
Reason: Core Enterprise Data Warehouse for analytics.
Addresses: REQ-012

nodes.title: AWS Glue
nodes.description:
Role: Serverless ETL, data cleansing, and cataloging.
Config: Job Type=Spark, Glue Version=4.0, Worker Type=G.1X.
Reason: Serverless ETL for the analytics ecosystem.
Addresses: REQ-012

nodes.title: Amazon QuickSight
nodes.description:
Role: BI dashboards and visualizations on Redshift data.
Config: Edition=Enterprise, Data Source=Amazon Redshift.
Reason: Seamless serverless BI integration with Redshift.
Addresses: N/A

nodes.title: Amazon Athena
nodes.description:
Role: Serverless querying of CUR data in S3.
Config: Dedicated FinOps workgroup, Query results stored in S3.
Reason: Ad-hoc cost analysis for FinOps.
Addresses: REQ-027

nodes.title: Amazon Route 53
nodes.description:
Role: Public DNS for app endpoints and private DNS for service discovery.
Config: Public Zone=Alias to CloudFront, Private Zone=Associated with all VPCs.
Reason: Public domain routing and private service resolution.
Addresses: REQ-042

nodes.title: Amazon CloudFront
nodes.description:
Role: Global content delivery with low latency.
Config: Origin=ALB, Viewer Protocol=redirect-to-https, WAF Association=Enabled.
Reason: Reduce latency and provide first layer of DDoS defense.
Addresses: REQ-035, REQ-004

nodes.title: AWS Shield
nodes.description:
Role: Managed DDoS protection for public endpoints.
Config: Protected Resources=CloudFront, ALBs, EIPs, Level=Advanced.
Reason: Multi-layered DDoS mitigation.
Addresses: REQ-004

nodes.title: AWS WAF
nodes.description:
Role: Protects web apps from SQL injection and XSS.
Config: Scope=REGIONAL & CLOUDFRONT, Rules=AWS Managed Rule sets.
Reason: Secure all public endpoints.
Addresses: REQ-004

nodes.title: AWS IAM & IAM Identity Center
nodes.description:
Role: Manages access to AWS services securely.
Config: Identity Source=External IdP (SAML), MFA=Enforced.
Reason: Centralize identity management and enforce least privilege.
Addresses: REQ-025, REQ-044

nodes.title: AWS Organizations
nodes.description:
Role: Centralizes governance across multiple AWS accounts.
Config: Feature Set=ALL, Policy Types=SCP, Tag Policy.
Reason: Foundation for multi-account strategy.
Addresses: REQ-008, REQ-020

nodes.title: AWS Control Tower
nodes.description:
Role: Automates setup of secure multi-account AWS environment.
Config: Home Region=us-east-1, Guardrails=Mandatory and Strongly Recommended.
Reason: Implement AWS Landing Zone pattern.
Addresses: REQ-008, REQ-009

nodes.title: AWS Certificate Manager
nodes.description:
Role: Provisions and manages SSL/TLS certificates.
Config: Certificate Type=Public, Validation Method=DNS.
Reason: Encryption-in-transit with auto-renewing certificates.
Addresses: REQ-004
